title: Greer briefed Clinton's CIA director

tellings.quote: 93 94 95 I briefed the CIA director for Clinton in December 13th of 93

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO activist who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows, says he personally briefed Bill Clinton's CIA director on the subject on December 13, 1993. He tells Michels this first-hand, as one of several meetings in 1993, 1994 and 1995. If so, the question of UFOs would have reached the top of the CIA under Clinton.
